title: docs(spec): cite the /ai/models picker decision as cloud ADR-0028
body:
Fixes #24486

Clause-②: no

## What this does

`packages/spec` cited a bare `ADR-0028` beside `GET /api/v1/ai/models`. A bare number resolves against this repository's registry, where `docs/adr/0028-metadata-naming-and-namespace-isolation.md` is about metadata naming. The decision these lines mean is cloud's `docs/adr/0028-paid-tier-selectable-ai-model.md` (read by triage, comment 6262456627). AGENTS.md Prime Directive #13 says a cloud decision is cited from this repo as `cloud ADR-NNNN`, never as a bare number.

This PR qualifies the three lines, in the same wording PR #24482 used for the client TSDoc and the docs:

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3399`, JSDoc on `AiModelsResponseSchema`: "plan-filtered picker list (cloud ADR-0028)".
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:3402`, JSDoc on `models`: "exposes the cloud ADR-0028 allowlist".
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts:375`, test comment: "the cloud ADR-0028 allowlist".

JSDoc and comments only. No `.describe()` string, shape or generated file moves. `CHANGELOG.md` history is left as written.

A fresh `git grep ADR-0028 -- packages/spec` (excluding `CHANGELOG.md`) on `origin/main` `959ee317b` finds one more site, `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:4` ("Namespace-prefix rules (ADR-0028 current-state contract)"). That one is correct as written: it means this repository's ADR-0028 (namespace isolation), so it is not changed.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24486-spec-cloud-adr-0028-citation.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. The package's `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` verbatim, and the JSDoc reaches the built `.d.ts`: after the build, `grep -rl "picker list (cloud ADR-0028)" packages/spec/dist` hits `automation-api.zod-*.d.ts` / `.d.mts`, and the old bare wording has 0 hits. The published surface moves, so `skip-changeset` does not apply.

## Verification 

The full run below was on head `e27d6d3f60`, the fix commit. After that, `origin/main` `6b42b6bc8a` was merged in, giving head `c53d4f840e`. The diff against main is the same 3 files, and the gate derivation on the new head is byte-identical (86 commands). On `c53d4f840e` I re-ran the 42 build-free commands: all 37 direct `node scripts/...` gates, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:issue-citations` and `check:test-source-alias`. All 42 exited 0.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/protocol.test.ts`: 1 file, 186 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck: OK` over the test layer.
- `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs`: exit 0, "check-adr-anchors: OK (75 anchored file(s), ... 48594 citation(s) across 6480 file(s) resolve ...)". The script recognises `cloud ADR-NNNN` and skips it.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 86 commands. All 86 were run, and `--ran` with exit codes reconciles them: "86 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 82 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
  - Green, among others: `check:docs` ("227 generated files in sync with packages/spec"), `check:api-surface` ("public API surface + factory signatures unchanged"), `check:authorable-surface`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:issue-citations`. `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (roster under `.changeset`) also passed.
  - NOT MEASURED (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, unbuilt sibling packages, left to CI): `check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/formula`), `check:lean-entry-closure` (`@objectstack/objectql` dist), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (whole-workspace build), `check:type-check-debt`. None of them reads a comment in `packages/spec/src/api`.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:4` cites `ADR-0028` and correctly means this repository's record. It is noted here, not changed.
